en: Next time, on Dragon Ba―I mean―the{SAUT}special screening...
Oh hoh. This next one sounds like some{SAUT}"over 9000" business...
Over 9000? What are you talking{SAUT}about?
Wha―!? You don't know!? The whole{SAUT}world knows what that is!
I-Is that so? I'm afraid I don't{SAUT}understand either...
Quiet, please! Special screenings are{SAUT}not to be taken lightly...{PAGE}If you don't keep quiet, you'll face my{SAUT}power of 530,000!
Oh geez, she's goin' all out with this...
What would you have us do, Elizabeth?{SAUT}Please elaborate.
I'm glad you asked.{PAGE}This special screening asks that you find{SAUT}a police impersonator!{PAGE}A Shadow is creating confusion amongst{SAUT}the citizens of Kamo City.
That's unforgivable.{OPTION}You want us to take care of it?
Hell yeah! We'll just find the Shadow{SAUT}and put the hurt on 'im!

It may not prove as easy as it sounds.{PAGE}The Shadow has disguised itself as one{SAUT}of the police officers patrolling the city.{PAGE}In order to find it, you will need to find{SAUT}and speak with each of them.
Wow! So it'll be like an investigation?{SAUT}We'll be like actual detectives!
The question is: Will the fake police{SAUT}officer admit that he's a fake?
The Shadow will most likely try to lie its{SAUT}way out of being caught.{PAGE}Therefore, you'll need to speak to all of{SAUT}the police officers.
But how do we know which one{SAUT}is lying?
Ah... It's like a logic puzzle.
Logic puzzle?

It's a type of puzzle where you have to{SAUT}identify a contradiction among the{SAUT}information you are given.{PAGE}In this case, we must speak to the police{SAUT}officers and find the contradiction{SAUT}within their testimonies.
So we have to find the lie! Sounds like{SAUT}fun!
Got it.{OPTION}It's a little confusing...
Are you serious? I didn't get any of that...{SAUT}You're pretty smart, {f 6 1 30 0 0 0}.
No sweat! I've got your backs!
You needn't worry. It's not so bad once{SAUT}you give it a try.{PAGE}First and foremost, we'll need to find the{SAUT}police officers.
Let's see what you can do, Detective{SAUT}Prince.
